info.name: Apache Software Foundation Whimsy Public Data API
Apache Software Foundation Get Committee Info

items.docs: Returns detailed information about all ASF committees (PMCs), including their chairs, established dates, reporting schedules, and full member rosters with join dates.

info.name: Apache Software Foundation Get LDAP Committee Data

items.docs: Returns committee data sourced from ASF LDAP, listing all PMCs and their member rosters by Apache ID.

info.name: Apache Software Foundation Get LDAP Groups Data

items.docs: Returns Unix group data sourced from ASF LDAP, listing all groups and their member rosters by Apache ID.

info.name: Apache Software Foundation Get LDAP People Data

items.docs: Returns public people data from ASF LDAP, including display names and group memberships for all committers.

info.name: Apache Software Foundation Get ICLA Information

items.docs: Returns public ICLA (Individual Contributor License Agreement) information, listing committers who have signed ICLAs along with their public names.

info.name: Apache Software Foundation Get Member Information

items.docs: Returns publicly available information about ASF members, including member status and availability data.

info.name: Apache Software Foundation Get Podlings Data

items.docs: Returns information about incubator podlings, including their status, description, sponsor, mentors, and key dates.
